name: banza-l3-readiness
description: banza-l3-readiness (BX1.9): local, no-network preparation of the L3 federation surface. It reads the Operator Manifest, SimB pre-review, Conformidade L0, L1 and L2 readiness reports, and validates the minimum BANZA federation artifacts between two simulated operators — federation pair, federation intent, cross-operator trace linkage, trust & BRL material and a federation settlement obligation — computing the L3 readiness status IN RUST. L3 readiness is technical preparation of federation — NOT active federation, NOT production, NOT certification, NOT approval; it does not create an operator and does not move funds.
